import sys

def solve():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    m = int(data[1])
    if n > m:
        n, m = m, n
    if n == 1:
        if m % 6 == 0:
            print(m)
        elif m % 6 == 1:
            print(m - 1)
        elif m % 6 == 2:
            print(m - 2)
        elif m % 6 == 3:
            print(m - 3)
        elif m % 6 == 4:
            print(m - 2)
        elif m % 6 == 5:
            print(m - 1)
    elif n == 2:
        if m == 2:
            print(0)
        elif m == 3:
            print(4)
        elif m == 7:
            print(12)
        else:
            print(m * 2)
    else:
        if (n * m) % 2 == 1:
            print(n * m - 1)
        else:
            print(n * m)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
